provenance.note: Crawler model is described as REXOME25 (another machine) in the STEP file

frames.brep_files: CAD world frame, mm, Y up, crawler placement applied; placement of every part file = identity
frames.body_from_cad: p_body_m = R @ p_cad_mm / 1000 (CAD origin = body origin)
frames.inertia: about the part centroid, body axes, kg m^2

definitions.roller: solids fully inside the station box around a crawler_wheels.csv 'track roller' axis: |x - centre| <= 200.0 mm, |z - axis| <= 100.0 mm, y from the wheel bottom - 1.0 mm to the wheel top + 1.0 mm (CAD; the same 12 solids for a top bound up to -500 mm); station x = tread cylinder axis (body x)
definitions.shoe_unit: ground shoe (carries the 4 grouser pad planes) + every chain solid whose nearest shoe plate centroid (3D) is the plate above it: shoe plate, link pair, shoe bolts and nuts, side blocks and fasteners, track joint (pin, bushing, seal discs)
definitions.end_vs_flat: lowest grouser pad point > 0.001 mm above the floor = end shoe (gapped), else flat shoe
definitions.station_x: shoes: mean centroid Z_cad of the grouser pad planes (export_params.py rule); rollers: tread axis
definitions.gap: lowest grouser pad point - floor (YAML end_shoe_gap_m rule); lowest_above_ground_mm = lowest point of the whole part
definitions.order_index: 0-based, ascending body x; equals the index of the YAML array named in yaml_key (roller_x_m, end_shoe_x_m)
definitions.face_ranges: face_index ranges (inclusive) of TopExp_Explorer(prototype, FACE), same numbering as 01_cad/07_faces (only near-ground crawler faces are rows there)

left.margin_note: second-nearest minus nearest plate distance over the members

right.margin_note: second-nearest minus nearest plate distance over the members

volume_vs_solid_sum.note: volume_mm3 = per-solid sum (GProp Add) of the solids read back from the part; compound_volume_properties = VolumeProperties of the whole compound (info)

left_right_symmetry.note: com_y_mirror: (y_L - c_L) + (y_R - c_R) about each track centre line

face_index.note: ground faces are rows with selection ground_band (<= 50 mm) or grouser_tip; roller faces are above the band and not in the index
